subject: Q1 cold-chain SLA — service level review

thread.body: Sofia — we've had several late cold-chain deliveries this quarter. Our read is that Week 7 was the worst by far. Per SOW-2022-007 we'd like the quarter OTD confirmed and the service credit applied. — Daniel, Helix Procurement
Daniel — thanks, reviewing now against our delivery system of record. I'll come to the QBR with the confirmed quarter number, the weekly breakdown, and the credit. Talk soon. — Sofia
